title: EvaluatorInput
description: Runtime inputs for the Vocabulary evaluator. grade_level determines which branch (grades_3_4 or other_grades) actually runs -- see the condition on each vocab_complexity step in config.json.

text.description: The passage to evaluate for vocabulary complexity.

grade_level.description: Target student grade. String, matching evaluator.supported_grades' own convention in config.schema.json (which must be strings to allow 'K').
